site.name: MGX Demand Check
site.tagline: See how many buyers are looking for a company like yours. Anonymous, free, two minutes.
site.sample_notice: Prototype. Buyer figures come from an illustrative, fictional sample, not from real MGX data.
site.footer: A prototype built for Mergero. Buyer data is an illustrative, fictional sample.

promise.no_identity: Buyers never see who you are
promise.no_sharing: Nothing is shared without your permission

form.title: Who would buy your company?
form.intro: Answer four questions. You see the result immediately. No name, email or phone number needed.
form.ebitda_help: Profit before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation. A rough band is enough.
form.timing: When might a sale or new owner be relevant?
form.time_note: Takes about two minutes. Nothing is stored that identifies you.
form.error_required: Please answer the four required questions.

buyer_type_help.pe_platform: Funds looking for a company to build a group around.
buyer_type_help.pe_addon: Groups owned by a fund, buying companies to add to what they have.
buyer_type_help.strategic: Companies in your industry or a neighbouring one.
buyer_type_help.family_office: Investment companies of wealthy families, often long-term owners.
buyer_type_help.search_fund: Individual entrepreneurs backed by investors, looking for one company to run.

result.title: Buyer demand for your company
result.count_lead: buyers in our network are looking for companies like yours
result.count_lead_one: buyer in our network is looking for companies like yours
result.zero_body: No buyer in the sample network currently states criteria that fit this profile. Buyer demand changes as new buyers join. You can ask to be told when that happens.
result.small_body: A small number of buyers match. To protect their confidentiality we do not show exact numbers below {n}.
result.appetite: Combined investment appetite of these buyers
result.appetite_note: Sum of what these buyers say they want to invest in total, not an offer.
result.recent: {n} of them joined in the last 90 days
result.recent_few: Some of them joined in the last 90 days
result.value_basis: Based on typical EBITDA multiples of {low}x to {high}x for your industry and size.
result.value_none: A value based on profit multiples is not meaningful for a loss-making company. Buyers look at revenue, growth and the path to profit instead.
result.value_disclaimer: Indicative, based on market averages. A real valuation needs your numbers.
result.next_call_body: Talk to an M&A advisor about what these buyers look for. No obligation, no fees for a first call.
result.next_profile_body: We draft an anonymous profile of your company and ask matching buyers for feedback. Your name stays hidden.
result.next_updates_body: Get a short update when new buyers who fit your company join, at most once a quarter.

optin.title: Want to go further? Tell us how to reach you
optin.intro: Everything below is optional. Tick only what you want. You can withdraw any consent at any time.
optin.name: Your name
optin.company_help: Helps us prepare. Never shown to buyers.
optin.channels_help: Each box is a separate consent. None is required.
optin.error_contact: Please give an email address or a phone number.
optin.error_email_needed: Email consent and updates need an email address.
optin.error_phone_needed: Phone, SMS and WhatsApp consent need a phone number.
optin.error_no_consent: Please tick at least one way we may contact you.

consent.email: I agree that Mergero may contact me by email about selling or growing my company.
consent.phone: I agree that Mergero may call me by phone about selling or growing my company.
consent.sms: I agree that Mergero may send me text messages (SMS) about selling or growing my company.
consent.whatsapp: I agree that Mergero may message me on WhatsApp about selling or growing my company.
consent.updates: Send me a buyer demand update by email when new matching buyers join, at most once a quarter.
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw each consent at any time with the link in any message or by replying "stop".

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.body: We received your details. A Mergero advisor will review them personally.
thanks.confirm_title: One more step: confirm your email
thanks.confirm_body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Email contact and updates start only after you confirm.
thanks.demo_inbox: Demo inbox (the email that would be sent)
thanks.phone_body: An advisor will contact you on the channels you chose, usually within two working days.

confirm.subject: Please confirm your email address
confirm.body: Please confirm that you want Mergero to contact you at this address. Until you click the link we will not send you anything else.
confirm.ignore: If you did not request this, ignore this email. Nothing will happen.
confirm.done_body: Thank you. Your email consent is now active.
confirm.invalid: This confirmation link is not valid or was already used.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.what: What we collect: the answers to the four questions (not linked to you unless you opt in). If you opt in: name, email, phone, company name or business ID, your consents with their exact wording, version and time.
privacy.why: Why: to show you buyer demand, and, only with your consent, to contact you on the channels you chose. Legal basis: your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)).
privacy.who: Who sees it: Mergero advisors only. Buyers never see your identity. Nothing is sold or shared without your permission.
privacy.retention: Retention: contact details are deleted 24 months after our last contact with you, or earlier on request. Anonymous answers are kept as statistics.
privacy.rights: Your rights: access, correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent, objection, and complaint to your data protection authority.
privacy.ai: AI: an AI tool may draft internal notes and message suggestions. A Mergero person reviews every message before it is sent.
